name: smwgraphics-battle-mania-daiginjou-ghost-wail-temple
title: Battle Mania: Daiginjou - Ghost Wail Temple
description:
Background of the third level from the obscure Genesis game called Battle Mania: Daiginjou. In this game, you control two badasses heroines with guns and jetpacks that blast everything in their way, Madison and Crystal. The third stage is inside an japanese temple. Great fit for castle or eastern temple levels. Since it's a shoot em up game, the background is quite big. The original game uses parallaxing in the upper half of the background.

UPDATE: More accurate tilemap and better palette allocation. Better optimized map 16, as well.

Credit would be great, but is optional.
